card.name: Sit or lie down for low blood pressure
card.fires_on: Posture words (sit, lie, rise, stand) in advice about orthostatic hypotension or fainting, and partway through the words orthostatic and hypotension.

modes.label: Posture advice
modes.description: Verbs telling patients to sit, lie down, or rise slowly when dizzy or faint after a dose.
modes.example: Instruct patients to<< sit>> or lie down if symptoms develop after dose

modes.label: Inside orthostatic hypotension
modes.description: Middle pieces of the words hypotension or orthostasis in warnings about low blood pressure on standing.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for dizziness and vomiting, such as nausea, vom, and Chinese words for dizziness.
card.plain: It lights up on advice to sit or lie down when blood pressure drops and on the words for that drop.
